purpose: all 11 Ulrich stromal centroids against the human ALL-CELLS object, plus the fib/dec cells grouped by leiden_0.5 imported by barcode
CONTROL_NOTE: the 5 subtypes used as negative controls in the fib/dec object (Stro-1/2/3/4/6) are EXPECTED to be present in whole tissue, so that floor does not apply here; a gene-label permutation null replaces it and cross-class specificity is the informative control.
